Parameters for R markdown and the general running of the code.

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, 
                      cache = FALSE,
                      autodep = FALSE)
start_time = Sys.time()
recompute_analyses = FALSE 
```

Parameters necessary to use the package BEMOVI (includes sampling parameters).

```{r}
fps = 25 #Frames per second 
seconds_per_video = 5
total_frames = fps * seconds_per_video
measured_volume = 34.4 #volume measured for each video in µL
volume_recorded_μl = measured_volume
volume_recorded_ml = volume_recorded_μl * 10^-3
pixel_to_scale = 4.05
filter_min_net_disp = 25
filter_min_duration = 1 
filter_detection_freq = 0.1
filter_median_step_length = 3

time_points = 0:7
sampling_days = c(0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 28)

threshold_levels = c(13, 40) #These are the two lower threshold for pixel intensity for imageJ to distinguish between background and foreground. We analysed the videos using 13 as the minimum threshold, then did the same with 40. 

video.description.folder = "0_video_description/"
video.description.file = "video_description.txt"
merged_data_folder = "5_merged_data/"

columns_for_species_ID = c("mean_grey",
                           "sd_grey",
                           "mean_area",
                           "sd_area",
                           "mean_perimeter",
                           "mean_turning",
                           "sd_turning",
                           "sd_perimeter",
                           "mean_major",
                           "sd_major",
                           "mean_minor",
                           "sd_minor",
                           "mean_ar",
                           "sd_ar",
                           "duration",
                           "max_net",
                           "net_disp",
                           "net_speed",
                           "gross_disp",
                           "max_step",
                           "min_step",
                           "sd_step",
                           "sd_gross_speed",
                           "max_gross_speed",
                           "min_gross_speed")
```

Parameters related to resource flows.

```{r}
resource_flow_days = c(5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25)
size_effect_types = c("fixed", "decreasing_with_size")
fixed_label = "Disturbance percentage FIXED"
relative_label = "Disturbance percentage DECREASING WITH SIZE"
```

Parameters related to protists.

```{r}
protist_species = c("Ble", "Cep", "Col", "Eug", "Eup", "Lox", "Pau", "Pca", "Spi", "Spi_te", "Tet")
protist_species_indiv_per_ml = paste0(protist_species, "_indiv_per_ml")
protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml = paste0(protist_species, "_bioarea_mm2_per_ml")
protist_species_dominance = paste0(protist_species_bioarea_mm2_per_ml, "_dominance")
species_IDD_with_13_threshold = c("Col", "Cep", "Eup", "Lox", "Pau", "Pca", "Spi_te", "Tet")
species_IDD_with_40_threshold = c("Ble", "Spi")
```

Parameters related to ecosystems.

```{r}
ds_ecosystems = NULL
ds_ecosystems_effect_size = NULL
ecosystems_to_take_off = NA

connection_ordered = c("unconnected", "connected")
ecosystem_sizes_ml = c(6.43, 9.00, 15.00, 45.00)

ecosystem_info = read.csv(here("1_data", "ecosystem_info.csv"), header = TRUE) %>%
  rename(ecosystem_ID = culture_ID,
         ecosystem_type = eco_metaeco_type,
         ecosystem_size_ml = patch_size_ml) %>%
  mutate(connection = factor(x = ifelse(metaecosystem == "yes",
                                        "connected",
                                        "unconnected"),
                             levels = connection_ordered),
         disturbance_percentage = factor(x = ifelse(flow == "absolute",
                                                    "decreasing_with_size",
                                                    "fixed"))) %>%
  select(ecosystem_ID,
         system_nr,
         ecosystem_size_ml,
         trophic_type,
         connection,
         disturbance_percentage)

n_ecosystems = max(ecosystem_info$ecosystem_ID)

variables_ecosystems = c("bioarea_mm2_per_ml",
                        "indiv_per_ml",
                        "species_richness",
                        "shannon",
                        "evenness_pielou",
                        protist_species_indiv_per_ml,
                        protist_species_dominance)
```

Parameters related to meta-ecosystems.

```{r experiment}
                                        autotrophic_ecosystem_IDs = as.character(NA),
```

Name of the axes per response variable.

